title: Check: Equation of a Straight Line

questions.stem: In the equation $y = mx + c$, what does $m$ represent?
questions.explanation: In the standard form $y = mx + c$, the coefficient $m$ represents the gradient (slope) of the line.

questions.stem: A line has gradient $-2$ and $y$-intercept $3$. What is its equation?
questions.explanation: Using $y = mx + c$ with $m = -2$ and $c = 3$ gives $y = -2x + 3$.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the equation of a straight line?
questions.explanation: $y = 5 - 3x$ can be rewritten as $y = -3x + 5$, which is in the form $y = mx + c$ with $m = -3$ and $c = 5$. The other equations are quadratic, reciprocal, and exponential.
